key_components.HeaderNav: Sticky nav with brand logo, hazard strip header border, phone CTA button, emergency indicator badge.
key_components.KineticHero: Big punchy display headline with live dispatch timer, background video overlay, instant SMS/Call action buttons.
key_components.ServicesGrid: Bento-style grid featuring Guêpes, Frelons Européens, Frelons Asiatiques with macro imagery and detail modals.
key_components.IdentificationSection: Tabs or slider showing close-ups, sizes (12-17mm vs 20-30mm vs 25-35mm), nest structure, and aggressiveness rating.
key_components.ProcessTimeline: 6-card visual journey with step numbers (1. SMS -> 2. Diagnostic -> 3. RDV 2h -> 4. Sécurité -> 5. Destruction -> 6. Garantie 30j).
key_components.FranceMapPins: Custom SVG Interactive France & Occitanie Map with pulsing red markers for Toulouse, Colomiers, Muret, Blagnac, Tournefeuille, etc.
key_components.PricingCalculator: Interactive slider for height selection (<8m: 100€, 8-12m: 130€, >12m: 150€) showing exact inclusions.
key_components.VideoGalleryModal: Grid of high-def video cards with play buttons opening modal video overlays.
key_components.StickyCallSMSBar: Bottom fixed mobile floating bar with instant trigger for tel:+33675362405 and SMS prefilled message.
key_components.ContactQuoteForm: Clean dark form with inputs for name, phone, city, zip, photo attachment simulation, and prompt quote generation.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: MUST add data-testid in kebab-case to all interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, map pins, and cards (e.g. data-testid='hero-sms-button', data-testid='pricing-calculator-slider', data-testid='map-pin-toulouse').
testing_and_accessibility.contrast: APCA high contrast standards compliant. Pure black text on yellow elements, high opacity background blurs for non-collision reading.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use Phosphor Icons, Lucide, or Heroicons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
